meta.name: cost-optimization
meta.description: Optimize cloud costs across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI through resource rightsizing, tagging strategies, reserved instances, and spending analysis. Use when reducing cloud expenses, analyzing infrastructure costs, or implementing cost governance policies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 降低云服务开支并优化资源使用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的云服务账单持续走高又难以定位浪费。
copy.tagline_en: Cut cloud costs and optimize resource usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your cloud bill keeps climbing and you can't find where the waste is.

howto.what: 它按框架帮你降低 AWS、Azure、GCP、OCI 的云成本：先做资源盘点与成本标签，再调整规格、清理闲置资源，推荐预留容量、Spot/抢占式实例等付费方式，并给出 Terraform 配置和预算告警示例。
howto.when: 当任务涉及降低云费用、分析基础设施成本或实施成本治理策略时，技能会启用。

say.text: 看看 AWS 上哪些 EC2 实例利用率低，给出降配或删除建议。
say.note: 它会按利用率推荐调整或清理。

say.text: 写一个 S3 生命周期规则：30天转IA，90天转Glacier，1年过期。
say.note: 生成对应的 Terraform 配置。

say.text: 给 Azure 虚拟机加成本标签，设月预算超 80% 提醒。
say.note: 它会给出标签与预算告警的对应写法。

howto.what_en: It applies a structured framework to lower AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI cloud costs: inventory resources and cost tags, right-size or clean up idle resources, recommend reserved capacity or Spot/preemptible instances, and provide Terraform configurations and budget alerts.
howto.when_en: Activates when the task is to reduce cloud spending, analyze infrastructure costs, or implement cost governance policies.

say_en.text: Find underutilized AWS EC2 instances and suggest rightsizing or deletion.
say_en.note: Checks utilization and gives sizing or removal recommendations.

say_en.text: Draft an S3 lifecycle: IA at 30 days, Glacier at 90, expiration at 365.
say_en.note: Returns a Terraform lifecycle config for the bucket.

say_en.text: Set a monthly budget alert for Azure VMs, warn at 80% of spend.
say_en.note: Builds the corresponding budget and notification setup.
